description: Find cannabis strain profiles by name or genetics (Indica, Sativa or Hybrid). Returns up to 25 strains with page URL, slug, genetics and THC and CBD ranges. A strain is a plant lineage, not something a pharmacy dispenses — use find_products for that. Findabis publishes no effects, medical uses or side effects for strains, so none are returned and none should be inferred. For terpenes, flavours and lineage, use get_listing with kind "strain".

genetics.description: The strain type: Indica, Sativa or Hybrid.

query.description: Strain name or nickname, e.g. "Gelato". Omit to browse.

name: find_strains

thcPercent.description: A figure or a range, e.g. "18-22"

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find cannabis strains
